coston2.notes: ContractRegistry address is taken from the pinned periphery package and must be RPC-verified by scripts/resolve-coston2.mjs before use. At least two independent endpoints are required: every resolved runtime code hash is cross-checked against a second operator and a mismatch halts resolution, per the PRD malicious-RPC mitigation.

xrplTestnet.notes: Two independent endpoints are required by NFR-012/NFR mismatch-halt rules. Reachability of each endpoint is recorded in docs/evidence/phase-00.md.

usedFor: official FCC extension lifecycle and instruction/result contract
upstream.knownLimitation: Flare labels FCC beta. The scaffold defaults to SIMULATED_TEE=true. Framework directories must not be modified without an ADR.

usedFor: Solidity interfaces for FAssets IAssetManager and redemption structs
FDC IFdcHub, IFdcVerification and IPayment attestation types
upstream.knownLimitation: Interfaces are a periphery snapshot. Every address and selector taken from here must be re-checked by RPC against the live deployment.

usedFor: TypeScript ABI artifacts for the coordinator and verifier
upstream.knownLimitation: ABI artifacts must match the RPC-verified deployed selectors, not the other way round.

usedFor: underlying payment window and default rules
redemption completion and default entry points
upstream.knownLimitation: Implementation source is authoritative for semantics only when the pinned commit matches the Coston2 deployment. Deployment drift must be detected by RPC selector checks.

usedFor: FDC attestation request and response encoding reference
voting round and Merkle proof retrieval semantics
upstream.knownLimitation: Client behavior is not a substitute for verifying the on-chain FdcVerification contract.

usedFor: FCC extension proxy required to relay instructions to an extension
upstream.knownLimitation: The proxy stack may require Flare C-chain indexer credentials that are not public. Access status is tracked in docs/run/ACCESS_STATUS.md.

usedFor: official private-key extension pattern reference only
upstream.knownLimitation: Flare states this is a demonstration and warns against placing encrypted secrets on chain for production. Signet must not copy its secret-delivery model without an ADR.

usedFor: pinned copy of the official FAssets, FDC and FCC documentation used by this run
upstream.knownLimitation: Documentation is a lead, not proof. Every documented interface must be RPC-verified.

usedFor: transitive dependency of the pinned Flare periphery interfaces (IERC20 and friends)
upstream.knownLimitation: Pinned because flare-foundry-periphery-package declares @openzeppelin-contracts 5.2.0-rc.1 via soldeer. Signet contracts must not depend on OpenZeppelin beyond what the periphery interfaces require.

contracts.name: FlareContractRegistry
contracts.knownLimitation: Registry contents can change by governance. Re-resolve before every deployment.

contracts.name: AssetManagerFXRP
contracts.knownLimitation: FAssets on Coston2 is a diamond-style deployment; selector presence is proven through the live dispatcher, not through a source match.

contracts.name: AssetManagerController
contracts.knownLimitation: Used only to enumerate asset managers; never a payment authority.

contracts.name: FdcHub
contracts.knownLimitation: Attestation requests are payable; the fee must be read from FdcRequestFeeConfigurations at request time.

contracts.name: FdcVerification
contracts.knownLimitation: Deployed behind FdcVerificationProxy, so selectors are not expected in the proxy runtime code; presence in the EIP-1967 implementation is the authoritative check.

contracts.name: FdcRequestFeeConfigurations
contracts.knownLimitation: Fee schedule is governance-controlled and must be read per request.

contracts.name: Relay
contracts.knownLimitation: Relay holds the FDC Merkle roots; proof verification is only as fresh as the relayed round.

contracts.name: FlareTeeManager
contracts.knownLimitation: FCC is beta and the manager is a diamond. Selectors are proven through DiamondLoupe.facetAddress, and the resolved facet must match the pinned scaffold manifest.

facetExceptions.reason: The live FCC diamond routes this selector to a facet the pinned scaffold manifest does not name. FCC is beta and the manifest is a snapshot. Recorded as a known, dated exception so the gate still fails if the facet changes again or if a new unpinned facet appears on any other selector.
